items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Margaret 'Queenie' Johnson only in a note regarding discographies and the interviewer's commentary; the interviewee (Gene Ramey) does not mention her or describe any personal interaction.

ctx.x: Where does he play and work now?
*Both the Rust and Bruyninckx discographies indicate Holiday recorded in September, 1938 with a Margaret "Queenie" Johnson in New York.
He's in Kansas City playing piano.
